- Replace `Dinero({ amount }).toFormat()` with `toDecimal(dinero({ amount, currency: USD }), ...)`

- Replace `.getAmount()` with `toSnapshot(...).amount`
- Replace `.isPositive()` with `isPositive(...)`
- Remove `@types/dinero.js` (v2 ships built-in TypeScript types)
- Update `dinero.js` from 1.9.1 to 2.0.0
